operation.title: What to do
operation.description: Verify businesses against their state registry, search UCC liens, or list which states each check covers (coverage needs no API key).

apiKey.title: Clerkfield API key
apiKey.description: Your free Clerkfield API key (starts with cf_live_). Create one at https://clerkfield.com/app#profile. Not needed for coverage.

businesses.title: Businesses to verify
businesses.description: One object per business: name (as the applicant gave it), state (two-letter state of formation), and optionally owner (checked against the officers the state lists) and minMonths (minimum months in business, default 6).

lienState.title: Lien search: state
lienState.description: Two-letter state code whose UCC filing office to search, usually where the business is organized.

lienSearchBy.title: Lien search: search by
lienSearchBy.description: Search filings against a business (debtor), for example to check for stacking, or every filing a lender (secured party) has made in the state.

lienName.title: Lien search: business or lender name
lienName.description: The business's legal name (for a debtor search) or the lender's name (for a secured-party search).

includeInactive.title: Lien search: include lapsed and terminated filings
includeInactive.description: Lapsed and terminated filings show lending history. Turn off for active filings only.
